equity_bridge.item: Equity securities at fair value (EquitySecuritiesFVNINoncurrent) and equity-method investments (EquityMethodInvestments) at 2026-06-30
equity_bridge.note: 38 + 31. Their income (investment gains/losses, equity-method share ~13/yr) sits below operating profit and is not in the flows, so the assets enter the bridge under the matching-asset rule. ~0.20/share; immaterial.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: Judgment: midpoint of guided mid-to-high single-digit system sales growth (constant currency) and the 7.4% 5-year USD revenue CAGR, trimmed for the rising franchise mix (franchise units yield fee revenue, not sales). Equity CAGR rejected as the anchor.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Parent shareholders' equity CAGR is NEGATIVE (-6.0% 3yr, -2.8% 5yr; 6,206 FY2020 -> 5,379 FY2025) because 4.5bn of buybacks and dividends since 2022 exceed retained earnings -- it diverges from revenue (+7%) by far more than 30% and says nothing about operating growth. EPS 3yr CAGR of 33.9% is off the FY2022 lockdown trough (1.05) and is not a base either. Owner-FCF CAGRs (5.1% / 2.8%) trail reported FCF (4.6% / 3.9%) on the 5-year window because interest income rose from 43 (FY2020) to 92 (FY2025) and was stripped; SBC itself is flat at ~0.35% of revenue and is not eating into growth.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series = reported FCF - SBC - net interest income, all from SEC XBRL: FY2020 695 - 36 - 43 = 616; FY2022 734 - 42 - 84 = 608; FY2025 840 - 42 - 92 = 706. Revenue FY2020 8,263, FY2022 9,569, FY2025 11,797. EPS FY2020 2.01, FY2022 1.05, FY2025 2.52. Equity (parent) FY2020 6,206, FY2022 6,482, FY2025 5,379.

scenario_narratives.base: Unit-led growth at mid-single digits with flat-to-slightly-positive same-store sales, a 15.3% to 16.0% pre-SBC EBITDA margin, capex easing as franchising rises, and the FY2026 guidance (high-single-digit operating profit growth, >1,900 net new stores, 1.5bn capital return) met. Value is a 7%-of-revenue owner-FCF stream growing ~6% then fading, plus 1.26bn of net cash.
scenario_narratives.bull: Same-store sales recover to +2-3%, coffee becomes a third brand at scale, the 30,000-store target lands on time, RMB appreciation adds to USD growth and margin reaches 17%. Needs several things to go right at once, which is why its weight is trimmed.
scenario_narratives.bear: Domestic low-cost chains reprice value perception across QSR, same-store sales go negative, lower-tier units dilute returns and the company-operated cost base de-levers to a 13.5% margin; growth 2-3%. Delisting rhetoric keeps the multiple compressed. Still cash-generative with no balance-sheet stress.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Yum China is valued as a mature, cash-generative, company-operated restaurant network whose growth is almost entirely new units rather than same-store productivity. The valuation strips SBC and interest income, carries the 2,180 of operating leases as the operating cost they already are in US GAAP, folds the 7.4% minority leakage into a combined tax rate, and holds the share count flat while the 4.5bn capital-return programme funds it. The terminal value is Gordon-bound at 9.5%/2.5% rather than cap-bound, so the result is a fair-value estimate for a 6%-then-fading grower, not a multiple-expansion bet.
key_risks_to_valuation: Same-store sales: the base assumes flat-to-+2%; sustained negative comps would push the outcome toward the bear path because the fixed, company-operated cost base de-levers quickly.
Price competition from Mixue, Luckin, Guming and local chains spreading into KFC/Pizza Hut's core price tiers.
RMB/USD: all flows are RMB; a 5% RMB depreciation lowers every USD figure in the model proportionally.

Lower-tier and franchise expansion economics: capex and D&A paths assume unit growth gets cheaper per dollar of revenue; if lower-tier units underperform, capex stays at 5%+ and margin does not reach 16%.
US-listed China ADR delisting risk (HFCAA, political rhetoric): economic value survives via the Hong Kong listing but a forced migration would be disorderly for US holders.
Food-safety incidents, which have historically produced sharp if temporary traffic losses.
Capital-return discipline: the model credits 1.26bn of net cash; if management keeps returning more than FCF beyond 2026, interest income falls further (already stripped) and the cushion erodes.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API (query1.finance.yahoo.com v8 chart, YUMC) at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 39.72-58.39. Parity check against 9987.HK and USDHKD=X from the same API, see inputs.fx_note.
data_sources.financials: SEC XBRL companyfacts API (CIK 0001673358): Form 10-K FY2025 and Form 10-Q Q1/Q2 2026 for all balance-sheet anchors, cash-flow components, interest income, NCI, lease liabilities and share counts; research/YUMC/Reports/YUMC_Metrics.csv for the annual history (XBRL-built; no PDFs extracted for this ticker).
data_sources.qualitative: research/YUMC/Reports/YUMC_Analysis.json (2026-10-04): business model, competitive position, Q2 2026 results and reiterated FY2026 and 2026-28 guidance, bull and bear cases.

inputs.base_revenue_note: TTM to 2026-06-30 = FY2025 11,797 + H1-2026 6,409 - H1-2025 5,768 (SEC XBRL us-gaap:Revenues). TTM chosen as FY0 so the flows, the balance sheet and the share count share one date.
inputs.share_count_basis: 345M common shares outstanding at 2026-06-30 (10-Q Q2 2026, CommonStockSharesOutstanding) plus ~1M dilutive awards (Q2 2026 diluted 349M vs basic 348M weighted average). Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows, so diluting the count as well would charge it twice. The 10-Q cover count of 342.46M at 2026-08-04 reflects Q3 buybacks funded with cash that is not yet out of the June balance sheet, so it is not used. Buybacks are heavy (TTM 1,306) and more than fund the flat count.
inputs.net_debt_note: Cash 485 + short-term investments 901 (bank time deposits and wealth-management products, ShortTermInvestments) = 1,386 at 2026-06-30. The 2023-24 'long-term bank deposits and notes' line (1.1bn at end-2023) no longer appears on the June 2026 balance sheet; OtherAssetsNoncurrent is only 374 and is not treated as cash. Debt = short-term borrowings 66 + finance lease liabilities 56 = 122. Operating lease liabilities of 2,180 are EXCLUDED (see lease_treatment). Equity securities (38) and equity-method investments (31) are carried in equity_bridge, not cash.
inputs.sbc_source: SEC XBRL us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation cash-flow add-back, TTM to 2026-06-30 (42 FY2025 + 23 H1-2026 - 22 H1-2025). No withholding-tax-on-equity-awards line is tagged in the filings (PaymentsRelatedToTaxWithholdingForShareBasedCompensation absent), so the add-back is used as the combined figure; at 0.35% of revenue the omission is immaterial.
inputs.interest_income_note: us-gaap:InterestIncomeExpenseNet TTM = 92 (FY2025) + 28 (H1-2026) - 51 (H1-2025). Stripped because net cash (1,264) exceeds the owner-FCF base (828); the cash pile is added back once in the bridge instead. Interest income has halved since FY2023 (169) as the 4.5bn 2024-26 capital return has drawn the cash pile down.
inputs.buyback_note: Actual financing-activity outflow TTM to 2026-06-30 (PaymentsForRepurchaseOfCommonStock 1,144 FY2025 + 530 H1-2026 - 368 H1-2025). Common dividends TTM 376. Total return 1,682 exceeds owner FCF because the 4.5bn 2024-2026 programme is deliberately running the cash balance down; management guides ~100% of FCF (after minority dividends) returned from 2027. Remaining authorisation at 2026-06-30: 641.
inputs.fx_note: Reporting and quote currency are both USD (Form 10-Q statements in US$ millions), although 100% of operations are RMB-denominated and USD growth carries translation noise (H1-2026 revenue +11% reported vs ~+5% ex-FX). Dual-listing parity: 9987.HK HK$317.40 at 2026-10-02 08:08Z / USDHKD 7.8463 = US$40.45, 1.2% above the NYSE regular close on the same date, explained by the HK close preceding a -2.4% NYSE session. Direction and quote basis confirmed; no conversion applied.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-02T20:00:02Z regular close (NYSE, Friday); valuation written Saturday 2026-10-04, no after-hours print involved
inputs.wacc_rationale: 9.5% built in USD, the currency of the flows: 10-year UST ~4.1%, US ERP ~4.8%, beta ~0.9 for a mature quick-service operator, plus ~1.5pp country/ADR premium for 100% mainland-China earnings and the HFCAA/delisting overhang => cost of equity ~9.5-10%. Debt is negligible (122 against a 13.8bn market cap), so WACC ~= cost of equity; 9.5% used. Same rate in all three scenarios -- China consumer, price-war and delisting risk are charged in the scenario flows and weights, not stacked on the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: US GAAP ASC 842: operating lease cost (498 FY2025, 256 H1-2026) is an operating expense above operating profit and the payments (504 FY2025) run through operating cash flow, so reported EBITDA, EBIT and FCF already bear the full rent charge -- treatment (B) by construction. Operating lease liabilities (2,180) are therefore excluded from net debt and lease_cost_pct_path is held at 0 to avoid charging rent twice. Finance leases (56) are small, their principal sits in financing, and they are included in total_debt instead. Multiples read against this model must use ex-lease EV over post-rent EBITDA.
inputs.nci_treatment: Non-controlling interests (704 book at 2026-06-30; KFC city JVs in Shanghai, Suzhou, Wuxi, Hangzhou and the Lavazza JV) took 78 of 1,053 total profit TTM, 7.4%. Charged ONCE, in the flows: the cash_tax_rate_path is a combined tax-and-leakage rate, 1 - (1 - 0.28 cash tax) x (1 - 0.074 NCI share) = 33%. Calibration: TTM EBIT 1,382 x 0.67 = 926 vs attributable net income 975 less after-tax non-operating income (~32) = 943, a 1.8% gap. No NCI deduction is made in the bridge.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF, 10-year horizon (margins still ramping gently; terminal-year margin flat), scenario-weighted, per .claude/skills/dcf-methods/references/owner-fcf.md with the adaptations file for leases and NCI. Routing: a company-operated restaurant operator (KFC/Pizza Hut/Taco Bell China, ~94% company sales) is a plain operating company; no banking, REIT or holdco features. First valuation of this ticker -- no MEMORY.md entry. EBITDA in the driver paths is PRE-SBC (reported operating profit + D&A + SBC: TTM 1,382 + 466 + 43 = 1,891 = 15.2%), because the engine deducts SBC as its own line; the Metrics CSV EBITDA column (1,848 TTM) is post-SBC. The CSV NetIncome column is profit including NCI (ProfitLoss), not attributable. Reported EPS history: FY2022 (1.05) was the COVID-lockdown trough, FY2021 included a 628 one-off remeasurement gain on the Hangzhou KFC step acquisition; neither is a base. Working capital held at 0% capture: OCF less (profit + D&A + SBC) was +55, -78 and -28 in FY2023-25, i.e. no durable negative-working-capital tailwind to bank. Guidance used for year 1 (Q2 2026 call, 2026-07-30): FY2026 same-store sales index 100-102, system sales mid-to-high single digit, operating profit high-single-digit growth, slight margin improvement, >1,900 net new stores, capital return 1.5bn; medium-term 2026-28 system sales mid-to-high single digit, operating profit high-single-digit, EPS/FCF per share double-digit. H1-2026 revenue grew 11.1% reported with an RMB tailwind that fades in H2, so year 1 (TTM to Jun-2027) is set at 7%.

bear.narrative: The price war led by Mixue (~45,000 stores) and Luckin (36,000+) spreads from coffee and tea into chicken and pizza value tiers; same-store sales turn negative and new lower-tier units cannibalise and dilute, so unit growth translates into only 2-4% revenue growth. Pizza Hut's delivery-mix margin erosion (Q2 2026 -40bp) becomes the group pattern and the company-operated cost base (labour, rent) de-levers: pre-SBC EBITDA margin falls ~180bp to 13.5%. D&A rises against weaker sales. A US delisting episode is survivable via 9987.HK but keeps the discount on the shares; terminal growth 2.0%. The scenario does not approach the zero-TV floor -- this is a lower-return compounder, not a solvency case.

base.cash_tax_rate_note: Combined: ~28% cash tax (TTM tax paid 399 on pretax 1,425; PRC 25% statutory plus dividend withholding on repatriation) and 7.4% NCI leakage on the after-tax residual. See inputs.nci_treatment.
base.narrative: Year 1 follows FY2026 guidance net of the fading RMB tailwind (7% USD), then mid-single-digit growth from ~1,900 net new units a year against flat-to-+2% same-store sales, decaying to 2.5% by year 10 as store density and the franchise mix rise. Pre-SBC EBITDA margin edges from 15.3% to 16.0% (management's 'slight improvement' continued for a few years, then flat): delivery mix and Pizza Hut's value repositioning cap the upside. Capex drifts from 5.1% to 4.6% of revenue as smaller formats and franchising do more of the unit growth; D&A follows. Gordon at 9.5%/2.5% (14.6x) sits just under the 15x cap, so Gordon binds.

bull.narrative: Same-store sales recover to +2-3% as the Chinese consumer stabilises, the 30,000-store 2030 target is met on schedule, K Coffee (5,000+ cafes by 2029) and Lavazza add a genuine third leg, and the RMB keeps appreciating against the dollar. Margin expands a further ~170bp on supply-chain scale, digital order mix (65% of system sales from members) and franchise-model leverage. Terminal growth 3.0%; cap unchanged at 15x -- the bull case is earned in the flows, not granted through a higher exit multiple.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 25%: 100% single-country exposure to a soft Chinese consumer, structural price competition from hyper-efficient domestic chains that has already flattened same-store sales, and recurring US delisting rhetoric (mitigated by 9987.HK but not priced away). Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it requires a same-store recovery, coffee scaling and a favourable RMB simultaneously. Base 50%: the FY2026 guidance has been reiterated through two quarters of record operating profit and nine periods of margin expansion, and the balance sheet carries no refinancing risk.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
sanity_check.fy_end_month_source: December (fallback: no fiscal_year_end and no annual filing)
